description: MiG-21FL supplied by the IAF to the Abhijeet Aerospace Safety Foundation's Jeet Aerospace Institute (founded by the parents of Flt Lt Abhijeet Gadgil, killed 2001). Perched on three concrete pillars. warbirds.in text inconsistently calls it C603; the photo caption and Bharat Rakshak give C-601, which is used here. Bharat Rakshak now words it "ex-Jeet Aerospace Institute" - status needs on-site check. Coordinates from warbirds.in map tag.
